evidence.reason: Outbox.spool admits any value that passes validate and durably writes canonical(value) without checking the record against RECORD_BYTES. Since GitLedger.publish enforces that bound on pending records, an admitted review with unbounded payload.paths can become an oversized pending record that cannot be published, leaving it to block later publishes. The smallest compatible fix is to enforce the record bound at spool admission (or bound the schema fields) before the atomic write.
